correctness.rationale: Every derivation preserves the center. The derivation condition for the arbitrary center-preserving triple (B,f,lambda) is B^T J+J B=lambda J. A standard symplectic block computation proves evaluation surjectivity sp(V)v=V at every v!=0 over every field, including char2; this constructs matching derivations for all x. Dimensions and finite cardinalities follow by exact parameter counts. Standalone verification independently exhausts local constraints over F2,F3,F5 in ranks up to 3.

value.rationale: The main gap is an exact full algebraic-reflexive hull for the standard Heisenberg family, beyond known existence and low-dimensional examples. The result gives the entire center-preserving parabolic, an increasing local/global defect n(2n-1), and exact finite-field probabilities including characteristic two. These are natural, motivated structural invariants relevant to current local-to-global rigidity research; significance is not based on small-sample computation alone.
